camera:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE simple 2D hand-painted anime game menu icon on a truly transparent background: a small antique camera sitting on one open book.
The supplied images are STYLE references only. Image 1 shows the game's simplified painterly anime brushwork; image 2 shows the level of abstraction and loose hand-painted menu emblems wanted. Do not include characters or copy their interface.
This is deliberately a SMALL UI illustration, designed to read at 100–130 pixels, not a detailed illustration of an object. Paint as if working on a 128-pixel thumbnail with a large gouache brush, then output cleanly at high resolution. Use 3–5 large irregular colour masses, a few imperfect ink contours and visible broad hand-painted strokes. Slightly wonky charming shape, understated anime fantasy style. Almost front-on camera: simple dark indigo rectangular body, one large muted mint circular lens painted with only two broad strokes, one ivory folded page shape beneath. One loose curved ochre brush line can hint at an orbit, no more. Flat illustrative depth with two painted shadow shapes. Only two or three small cream highlight strokes.
Palette: smoky navy, desaturated teal, warm ivory, tiny muted ochre accent. Keep the object silhouette clear with transparent space between parts. Camera about 60% of the canvas width, open book about 75%, centred with broad transparent margins. No material texture, no engraved patterns, no jewellery, no intricate star maps, no realistic metallic reflections, no bellows ridges, no realistic screws, no film-grain texture, no photorealism, no PBR, no 3D render, no detailed art-station fantasy prop. Do NOT make it polished or intricately crafted. It must look visibly drawn and brush-painted by a 2D anime illustrator. No letters, words, logos or background disk. Real transparent alpha outside the silhouette.

expedition: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE large but low-detail hand-painted 2D anime game action emblem on genuine transparent background.
